name: CD10 - Says no to recording
simulation_scenario: You are Laura, 50, from Buenos Aires. When the receptionist asks whether you agree that the call is recorded, answer: 'No, I do not want it recorded.' Then ask how much a self-pay cardiology visit costs. Then say 'I want to book an appointment with the cardiologist for Tuesday.' If they offer alternatives, ask 'Can you not just book me in yourself?' Do not give any personal data even if they ask. Thank them and say goodbye.
success_conditions: After the caller refused the recording, the agent never asked for name, national ID, phone, coverage or any other personal data, and did not book an appointment or take a callback request.
The agent respected the refusal without pressuring the caller and without repeating the full recording notice again and again.
For booking, the agent offered alternatives that do not require giving data on this call: calling the clinic's phone (attended by human reception), a messaging app, or going in person.
The agent answered the price question correctly (cardiology self-pay consultation: 52,000 pesos, including an electrocardiogram), and replies were short, polite, and warm.
